MODAL.TITLE: Whatsapp Templates
MODAL.SUBTITLE: Select the whatsapp template you want to send

PARSER.FORM_ERROR_MESSAGE: Please fill all variables before sending
PARSER.MEDIA_NAME_PLACEHOLDER: Name the customer will see (e.g. Invoice A1.pdf)
PARSER.TEMPLATE_FILE: The template's file will be sent:

ERRORS.BODY: Fill in all the body variables.
ERRORS.MEDIA_URL: Enter the public link to the file (must start with http:// or https://).
ERRORS.COPY_CODE_LENGTH: The copy code can have up to %{max} characters.

WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_EDITOR.NEW_DESC: Build the message, check the preview and send it to Meta for review. If you don't finish it, save it as a draft.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_EDITOR.DRAFT_DESC: This is a draft: it hasn't reached Meta yet. You can change everything except the inbox.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_EDITOR.EDIT_DESC: Meta only lets you change the category and the content; name, language and inbox stay fixed. Saving sends the template back to review.

FIELDS.NAME: Name
FIELDS.NAME_HINT: Formatted automatically: lowercase, no spaces or accents. It can't change once it reaches Meta.
FIELDS.OR_LINK: …or paste a public link to the file (https://…)
FIELDS.BODY_PLACEHOLDER: Write the message. Use variables like %{variable} for data that changes on each send.
FIELDS.EXAMPLES: Variable examples: Meta reviews them and they show in the preview.
FIELDS.FOOTER_PLACEHOLDER: Short footer, no variables (e.g. your company name)
FIELDS.NO_VARIABLES: The message has no variables. Type %{variable} in the text to add one.

CATEGORY_HINTS.UTILITY: Updates about something the customer already asked for: payments, appointments, orders, shipping.
CATEGORY_HINTS.MARKETING: Promotions, offers and invitations. Meta reviews and charges them differently from utility ones.
CATEGORY_HINTS.AUTHENTICATION: Verification codes: they have a fixed format and are created in Meta's WhatsApp Manager.

LIMITS.IMAGE: JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB

BUTTONS.HINT: Quick replies go first; then link (max. 2), phone (1) and copy code (1).

PREVIEW.CAPTION: This is how the customer will see it in WhatsApp.

ALERTS.SUBMITTED: Template sent to Meta for review.
ALERTS.RESUBMITTED: Changes sent: the template goes back to review.
